title.zh: 11莱露 · 士气交棒与分批火刀
title.en: Soldier 11 / Lighter / Lucy · Morale handoff and Fire Suppression batches

summary.zh: 根据原作者正文与固定技能整理的条件式教学：露西加攻、莱特士气爆发、11号分批续火刀；不是作者逐帧原轴或最高分实测。
summary.en: Conditional teaching assembled from original articles and fixed skills: Lucy buffs, Lighter spends Morale, Soldier 11 refreshes Fire Suppression in batches. Not an author’s frame-perfect or highest-score test.

conditions.zh: 循环站位露西→11号→莱特，让露西的快支交给11号；莱特80士气快支由其自身条件触发。
conditions.en: Use Lucy → Soldier 11 → Lighter cyclically; Lucy assists into Soldier 11, while Lighter has his own 80-Morale entry.

conditions.zh: 0影无专武可执行；11号、露西的同火属性条件与莱特强攻/同阵营队友条件满足。
conditions.en: Executable at M0 without signatures; Fire satisfies Soldier 11/Lucy, and Attack/same faction satisfies Lighter.

conditions.zh: 本轴仅非潜能分支，不包含火力迸发、蓄力拼刀或第五段潜能机制。火刀当前固定源为30秒或8次，非旧攻略15秒。
conditions.en: This route excludes Potential branches, charged clashes and the Potential fifth stage. Fixed current data gives 30 seconds or eight uses, not the old guide’s 15 seconds.

label.zh: 小橙子 · 莱特与11号火队（1.3）
label.en: Orange · Lighter and Soldier 11 Fire team (1.3)

objective.zh: 先加油，利用11号准备等待莱特士气
objective.en: Establish Cheer On and prepare Soldier 11 while Morale builds

title.en: Lucy fly ball: confirm Cheer On

input.zh: 有能量时长按强化特殊技，等小猪落地爆炸；实际命中才接快支。
input.en: With energy, hold EX for the fly ball and wait for the explosion; take Quick Assist only after a real hit.

trigger.zh: 加油需要建立或刷新，露西能量足够。
trigger.en: Cheer On needs setup/refresh and Lucy has enough energy.

complete.zh: 爆炸后确认加油；命中敌人且11号提示出现时再交棒。
complete.en: Confirm Cheer On after the explosion; hand over only after an enemy hit and Soldier 11 prompt.

reason.zh: 爆炸加攻与命中触发快支是不同条件；无需假定全部队友当前都站场。
reason.en: Explosion-based ATK and hit-based Quick Assist are separate conditions.

fallback.zh: 空挥或提示未出现先等/重新定位；无能量且0/1影不能把露西连携当加油。
fallback.en: After a miss, wait or reposition. Without energy at M0/1, Lucy Chain cannot substitute Cheer On.

signal.zh: 小猪命中敌人，11号快支提示出现。
signal.en: The boar hits an enemy and Soldier 11’s Quick Assist prompt appears.

input.zh: 按露西后面的11号快支提示入场，完成火力掩护。
input.en: Enter via the Soldier 11 prompt after Lucy and finish Covering Fire.

trigger.zh: 循环站位露西→11号→莱特；快支真实可用。
trigger.en: Use Lucy → Soldier 11 → Lighter cyclically, with a real assist prompt.

complete.zh: 快支完成后检查自己的火力镇压状态与能量。
complete.en: After the assist, check Fire Suppression and energy.

reason.zh: 快支本身不赠8次火刀，不能把它误当连携或EX。
reason.en: Quick Assist itself grants no eight-use Fire Suppression; it is not Chain or EX.

fallback.zh: 无提示可普通切入，但仍需EX、连携、Q或手动节奏取得火刀。
fallback.en: Without a prompt, switch normally; EX, Chain, Ultimate or timed Basics are still needed for Fire Suppression.

label.zh: 加油持续时提供加攻；按真实剩余时间。
label.en: Cheer On supplies ATK only for its actual remaining duration.

input.zh: 能量足够且需要续火刀时点按强化特殊技。
input.en: Press EX with enough energy when Fire Suppression needs refreshing.

trigger.zh: 已有火刀次数将尽或状态缺失；目标可攻击。
trigger.en: Existing automatic uses are nearly spent or absent, with a hittable target.

complete.zh: EX发动后取得最多30秒或8次的必定火力镇压；按本次实际消耗计算。
complete.en: After EX starts, automatic Fire Suppression lasts up to 30 seconds or eight triggers; count actual uses.

reason.zh: 不提前把多次EX/连携/Q叠成16或24次；先利用当前可用次数。
reason.en: Do not assume multiple EX/Chain/Ultimate uses stack into 16 or 24 charges; use the current allowance.

fallback.zh: 能量不够就看连携/Q真实就绪情况，或用手动节奏；不能假定普通特殊技也送8次。
fallback.en: If energy is short, check real Chain/Ultimate availability or timed Basics; ordinary Special grants no eight uses.

title.zh: 用火刀输出，读剩余次数
title.en: Deal Fire Suppression damage and track remaining uses

input.zh: 有必定火刀时连续普攻；没有时按训练掌握的时机点按，确认火属性命中。
input.en: With guaranteed uses, continue Basics; without them, use practiced timing and verify Fire hits.

trigger.zh: 有EX/连携/Q给出的必定次数，或能够实际打出手动火刀。
trigger.en: Guaranteed uses from EX/Chain/Ultimate remain, or manual timing succeeds.

complete.zh: 观察每刀是否火属性；次数用尽后选择续火刀或交莱特，不把普通物理刀当火刀。
complete.en: Check each Fire hit; when uses run out, refresh or hand to Lighter, without counting physical Basics as Fire Suppression.

reason.zh: 失衡期间集中兑现火刀；常态也可输出并等待莱特真实士气。
reason.en: Spend Fire Suppression in Stun windows; outside them, attack while Lighter actually builds Morale.

fallback.zh: 敌人反击先闪避/招架；火刀断了不硬凑固定八刀。失衡结束返回循环。
fallback.en: Defend against counterattacks and do not force eight hits; after Stun ends, return to the loop.

label.zh: 仅在加油仍有效时保留露西加攻。
label.en: Retain Lucy ATK only while Cheer On is active.

title.en: Enter Lighter with Quick Assist at 80 Morale

input.zh: 士气≥80后换入莱特，确认自身快支发动，再接普攻第五段。
input.en: At 80+ Morale bring Lighter in, confirm his own Quick Assist, then connect Basic 5.

trigger.zh: 士气实际达到80，下一次换入能触发自身快支。
trigger.en: Actual Morale reaches 80 and the next entry triggers his own Quick Assist.

complete.zh: 快支完成，进入可衔接第五段的状态；尚未命中不计增益。
complete.en: Complete the assist and connect Basic 5; no buff is credited before hits.

reason.zh: 这是莱特自身士气入口；普通切入未满足条件时不能写成快支。
reason.en: This entry uses Lighter’s own Morale mechanic; an ordinary entry does not count.

fallback.zh: 未满80就继续队友准备；若已普通切入，可用实际可用EX/普攻接第五段，仍检查80门槛。
fallback.en: Below 80 continue teammate setup; after an ordinary entry, reach Basic 5 legally and still check the 80 gate.

title.zh: 喷发第五段，终结一击命中
title.en: Land Morale-Burst Basic 5 and its finisher

input.zh: 80士气以上接第五段，持续点按/长按完成刺拳，等终结一击打中。
input.en: Enter Basic 5 at 80+ Morale, sustain the punches and land the final strike.

trigger.zh: 士气喷发真实开启，敌人处在可命中范围。
trigger.en: Morale Burst actually begins and the target remains in range.

complete.zh: 轻拳/刺拳命中叠昂扬与减抗；终结一击命中才计溃败与失衡延长。
complete.en: Punch hits build Elation and resistance reduction; the finisher must hit for Collapse and extended Stun.

reason.zh: 火队增益依实际命中，不因莱特在队伍就自动全开；提前切走会结束喷发。
reason.en: Fire-team buffs need real hits, not mere team membership; switching out ends Burst.

fallback.zh: 失衡出现就按真实连携给11号；若加油即将过期，失衡前先补露西。未失衡继续准备。
fallback.en: On Stun, use actual Chain prompts for Soldier 11. Refresh near-expiring Cheer On before Stun; otherwise continue setup.

prep.zh: 无开局EX能量就按恢复说明打普攻/等待；不假定所有模式开场满能量。
prep.en: If EX energy is absent, use recovery Basics/setup; no mode is assumed to start with full energy.

objective.zh: 刷新加油，80士气再交莱特
objective.en: Refresh Cheer On and hand to Lighter at 80 Morale

prep.en: Skip Lucy if Cheer On has sufficient duration; refresh missing Fire Suppression with an actually available EX.

prep.zh: 临近失衡时把露西刷新放在失衡前；不保证每轮固定动作数。
prep.en: Near Stun, refresh Lucy beforehand; no fixed action count is guaranteed.

objective.zh: 连携、EX、Q分批续火刀，不空耗次数
objective.en: Refresh Fire Suppression in Chain/EX/Ultimate batches

title.en: Enter the Stun window through Soldier 11 Chain

input.zh: 实际连携界面可选11号时选她，并完成动作。
input.en: Choose Soldier 11 from an actual Chain prompt and finish the action.

trigger.zh: 目标已失衡；露西加油与莱特命中增益已按实际状态检查。
trigger.en: The target is Stunned; actual Cheer On and Lighter hit conditions have been checked.

complete.zh: 连携发动后取得火力镇压，接普攻；不按固定连携次数拖延窗口。
complete.en: Chain grants Fire Suppression; continue Basics without forcing a fixed number of Chain selections.

reason.zh: 连携是免EX耗能的火刀入口，但没有提示就不能凭空发动。
reason.en: Chain supplies Fire Suppression without EX energy, but requires a real prompt.

fallback.zh: 无11号连携提示时可普通切入用EX开火刀；EX也不可用就手动节奏或返回准备。
fallback.en: Without a prompt, enter normally and use available EX; otherwise use timed Basics or return to setup.

title.zh: 可选：独立终结技续火刀
title.en: Optional: use her own Ultimate to refresh Fire Suppression

input.zh: 11号自己的喧响就绪且窗口仍在时发动终结技。
input.en: Use Soldier 11’s own ready Ultimate while a worthwhile window remains.

trigger.zh: Q实际可用；不要为等待Q把已结束的失衡当作仍在。
trigger.en: Ultimate is actually available; do not pretend an ended Stun remains while waiting.

complete.zh: Q发动后重新按最多30秒或8次检查火力镇压，再继续普攻。
complete.en: After Ultimate, recheck Fire Suppression for up to 30 seconds or eight triggers, then continue Basics.

reason.zh: 终结技按每人独立就绪判断，不继承1.0共用喧响的分配限制。
reason.en: Ultimates use each agent’s own readiness, not the version-1.0 shared-Decibel restriction.

fallback.zh: Q未就绪就跳过；剩余窗口不足时直接回莱特/露西循环。
fallback.en: Skip if unavailable; if the window is insufficient, return to Lighter/Lucy setup.

label.en: Retain Lucy ATK only while Cheer On is active.

prep.zh: 仅执行窗口与资源允许的批次；不是每轮都要打三组八次。
prep.en: Execute only batches allowed by the window and resources; three sets of eight are not required.

prep.zh: 若入场前已取得火刀，跳过重复入口；露西低于2影不能靠连携补加油。
prep.en: Skip duplicate entry if Fire Suppression is already active; Lucy below M2 cannot refresh Cheer On with Chain.

text.zh: 11号1影接战成为当前角色且能量低于40时回至80，有50秒冷却；不是每次切入送能量。
text.en: M1 restores energy to 80 on becoming active in combat below 40, with a 50-second cooldown; not every switch.

text.zh: 2影火刀触发时叠独立持续的增伤；按实际次数计层，不因此免除火刀条件。
text.en: M2 stacks timed damage boosts on Fire Suppression triggers; actual triggers and resource gates still matter.

text.zh: 6影EX/连携/Q给8层充能，火刀每次消耗1层以无视火抗；充能上限8，不可累成24层。
text.en: M6 grants eight Charges on EX/Chain/Ultimate; each Fire Suppression spends one for Fire RES ignore. The cap remains eight.

text.zh: 露西2影实际发动连携或Q可补10秒加油；有对应提示时可减少EX刷新，0/1影不继承。
text.en: Lucy M2 grants ten-second Cheer On on actual Chain/Ultimate use; this can replace EX refresh when available, never at M0/1.

text.zh: 6影要求加油中的队友EX命中才延时；每次重新取得加油后最多延长3次、总上限30秒。
text.en: M6 extends Cheer On only when a buffed teammate’s EX hits: at most three extensions per fresh application, up to 30 seconds.

text.zh: 莱特1影增强减抗与溃败延长；减抗看喷发轻拳/刺拳命中，失衡延长看喷发终结一击命中。
text.en: Lighter M1 improves resistance reduction and Collapse: Burst light punches/jabs apply the reduction, while the Burst finisher must hit for extended Stun.

text.zh: 莱特2影额外失衡倍率来自实际施加溃败，不是仅达到80士气。
text.en: Lighter M2’s extra Stun multiplier requires applying Collapse, not merely reaching 80 Morale.

text.zh: 硫磺石由普攻/冲刺/闪反实际命中叠攻击，层数独立计时；不直接提供火刀次数。
text.en: The Brimstone stacks separately timed ATK on actual Basic/Dash/Counter hits; it grants no Fire Suppression uses.

text.zh: 焰心桂冠冲击力需要快支/极限支援实际发动；普攻命中另叠萎靡，不能普通切入就算满层。
text.en: Blazing Laurel Impact requires a real Quick/Perfect Assist; Basic hits separately stack Wilt, not an ordinary switch.

text.zh: 好斗的阿炮按不同友方单位实际命中叠加攻；每个单位最多贡献1层，不把露西单人攻击直接当满层。
text.en: Kaboom stacks from actual hits by different allied units; each unit contributes at most one, not full stacks from Lucy alone.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.露西高飞球，确认加油: 长按强化特殊技，等落地爆炸
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.11号快支接手: 看到11号快支提示再入场
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.EX补火力镇压: 点按强化特殊技补火刀
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.80士气，莱特快支切入: 士气达到80后让莱特入场
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.喷发第五段，终结一击命中: 普攻第五段持续连打，等最后一击
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.可选：独立终结技续火刀: 可选：11号自己的终结技就绪再放

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.按露西后面的11号快支提示入场，完成火力掩护。: 出现指向11号的快速支援提示时，按支援键入场。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.有必定火刀时连续普攻；没有时按训练掌握的时机点按，确认火属性命中。: 还有必定打出火刀的次数时连续按普攻；没有时按火刀节奏点普攻，看是否实际打出火属性伤害。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.80士气以上接第五段，持续点按/长按完成刺拳，等终结一击打中。: 士气至少80时接普攻第五段，连点或长按普攻打出刺拳，等最后一击命中。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1041: 查看火力镇压次数：还有次数就连续按普攻；没有则按火刀节奏点普攻，或能量够时按强化特殊技补充。
ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1161: 先看士气；士气不足时按当前普攻连段推进，达到80并实际进入第五段才连打刺拳。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.104100002: 按火刀节奏点按普攻，等火属性攻击命中
ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.115100005: 能量足够时按强化特殊技，等小猪爆炸并命中

104100002: 本步用普攻打火刀：按火力镇压次数或火刀节奏连打，不要求在强化特殊技前固定打几下。
Use Basics for Fire Suppression here. Match the remaining guaranteed hits or timed inputs; no fixed pre-EX tap count.
116100001: 本步需要接到普攻第五段后连点或长按打刺拳；从快支直达第五段时不用从第一段重打。
Continue or hold Basic from hit 5 for the punches. If Quick Assist already linked to hit 5, do not restart from hit 1.
116100010: 快支后点按或长按普攻，可直接接第五段；本路线要打刺拳才接，不必先点五次。
After Quick Assist, tap or hold Basic for direct hit 5 when following the punches route. No five preliminary taps.

1041: 用普攻恢复按当前火刀次数与节奏，不按固定段数计；也可直接用有能量的强化特殊技补火刀。
If using Basics, follow the current suppression charges or timing, not a fixed count. EX with Energy is a separate recovery option.
1161: 士气不足可用普攻积累；达到80且接上第五段才连点或长按普攻。
Use Basics if building Morale. Tap repeatedly or hold only when Morale reaches 80 and hit 5 is available.
